rows.Steps: Set course priorities, four weekly feed posts, campaign briefs and owners.
rows.Turnaround / rhythm: Plan Wed; briefs Thu; production Fri; approve/schedule Sat.
rows.Checks / escalation: Start complex items earlier; retain original deadlines.

rows.Steps: Prepare script; collect inputs; coordinate shooting; edit; hand off with owner and deadline.
rows.Turnaround / rhythm: Brief 1 working day; standard edit 1 working day after complete inputs.
rows.Checks / escalation: Flag missing inputs and delays before deadline.

rows.Steps: Obtain academic checks, claims verification and permissions; approve a specific version.
rows.Turnaround / rhythm: Academic/final approval 1 working day each; revisions/reapproval half day each.
rows.Checks / escalation: Fees/offers/sensitive claims need Institute Authority. No sole self-approval.

rows.Steps: Schedule; verify live; record actual publication and link.
rows.Turnaround / rhythm: Schedule 24 hours ahead; check within 30 minutes during assigned coverage.
rows.Checks / escalation: No approval means no publication; arrange out-of-hours cover.

rows.Steps: Reply; collect sufficient details; deduplicate; assign in CRM; obtain acceptance.
rows.Turnaround / rhythm: Hourly inbox checks; reply within 1 operating hour; CRM entry within 30 minutes.
rows.Checks / escalation: Admissions accepts within 1 operating hour. Offer counselling same day or next day for late enquiries.
rows.Completion evidence: Lead ID, accepted owner and next action

rows.Steps: Configure campaign; verify creative, targeting, dates, budget, links and CRM test lead.
rows.Checks / escalation: Do not launch without admissions receiving owner and completed checks.

rows.Steps: Review quality and cost; document adjustment; reconcile spending at closure.
rows.Checks / escalation: Pause broken capture/wrong claims/uncontrolled spend. Budget increases, offers and extensions need approval.

rows.Steps: Confirm partner, budget and presenter; prepare registration/materials; execute; hand over enquiries.
rows.Turnaround / rhythm: Confirm 5 days before; readiness 2 days; reconfirm 1 day; CRM next working day.
rows.Checks / escalation: Permission required; attendees are not automatic leads; review within 3 working days.
rows.Completion evidence: Activity results and assigned CRM leads

rows.Trigger / input: CRM export, spend and content records
rows.Steps: Validate data; review weekly activity separately from cohorts; record decisions.
rows.Turnaround / rhythm: Monday 30-minute review; post review after 7 days; cohort checks 7/14/30 days.
rows.Checks / escalation: No duplicate leads or guessed attribution. No weekly admissions / new-leads conversion ratio.

rows.Steps: Set course priorities, four weekly feed posts, campaign briefs and owners.
rows.Turnaround / rhythm: Plan Wed; briefs Thu; production Fri; approve/schedule Sat.
rows.Checks / escalation: Start complex items earlier; retain original deadlines.

rows.Steps: Prepare script; collect inputs; coordinate shooting; edit; hand off with owner and deadline.
rows.Turnaround / rhythm: Brief 1 working day; standard edit 1 working day after complete inputs.
rows.Checks / escalation: Flag missing inputs and delays before deadline.

rows.Steps: Obtain academic checks, claims verification and permissions; approve a specific version.
rows.Turnaround / rhythm: Academic/final approval 1 working day each; revisions/reapproval half day each.
rows.Checks / escalation: Fees/offers/sensitive claims need Institute Authority. No sole self-approval.

rows.Steps: Schedule; verify live; record actual publication and link.
rows.Turnaround / rhythm: Schedule 24 hours ahead; check within 30 minutes during assigned coverage.
rows.Checks / escalation: No approval means no publication; arrange out-of-hours cover.

rows.Steps: Reply; collect sufficient details; deduplicate; assign in CRM; obtain acceptance.
rows.Turnaround / rhythm: Hourly inbox checks; reply within 1 operating hour; CRM entry within 30 minutes.
rows.Checks / escalation: Admissions accepts within 1 operating hour. Offer counselling same day or next day for late enquiries.
rows.Completion evidence: Lead ID, accepted owner and next action

rows.Steps: Configure campaign; verify creative, targeting, dates, budget, links and CRM test lead.
rows.Checks / escalation: Do not launch without admissions receiving owner and completed checks.

rows.Steps: Review quality and cost; document adjustment; reconcile spending at closure.
rows.Checks / escalation: Pause broken capture/wrong claims/uncontrolled spend. Budget increases, offers and extensions need approval.

rows.Steps: Confirm partner, budget and presenter; prepare registration/materials; execute; hand over enquiries.
rows.Turnaround / rhythm: Confirm 5 days before; readiness 2 days; reconfirm 1 day; CRM next working day.
rows.Checks / escalation: Permission required; attendees are not automatic leads; review within 3 working days.
rows.Completion evidence: Activity results and assigned CRM leads

rows.Trigger / input: CRM export, spend and content records
rows.Steps: Validate data; review weekly activity separately from cohorts; record decisions.
rows.Turnaround / rhythm: Monday 30-minute review; post review after 7 days; cohort checks 7/14/30 days.
rows.Checks / escalation: No duplicate leads or guessed attribution. No weekly admissions / new-leads conversion ratio.
